title: Riot Squad Cherry Menthol Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Fruit vape enthusiasts will be delighted with the Riot Squad Cherry Menthol Shortfill 50ml E-Liquid. This tantalising cherry menthol vape juice offers a blend of sweet and succulent candy cherries on the inhale and a satisfyingly cool menthol finish on the exhale. The Riot Squad Cherry Menthol vape flavour is authentic and rich. Evoking memories of plump, juicy cherries plucked straight from the tree. Which are then coated with a layer of sweet candy. Whilst the menthol adds a refreshing coolness that provides a smooth sensation on the throat. Perfectly complementing the sweet and delicious cherry flavour. This Cherry Menthol by Riot Squad 50ml E Liquid is perfect for those who crave menthol and cherry flavour vape juice, because it's a unique and mouthwatering blend that creates a delightful and refreshing vape experience. This delicious Riot Squad Cherry Menthol Shortfill 50ml is also available as a Riot Squad Nic Salt. Which is perfect for vapers looking to soothe their nicotine cravings with a super smooth throat hit. Don’t miss out, check out the equally delicious Riot Squad Cherry Menthol Nic Salt today! This convenient Cherry Menthol By Riot Squad 50ml nicotine-free Shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a Nicotine Shot to tailor your vape to your liking. For example, adding an 18mg Nic Shot will turn your 50ml Riot Squad Shortfills into 50ml of 3mg E Liquid. What’s more, this Riot Squad Shortfill E Liquid features a 70VG/30PG ratio. Making it ideal for Sub-Ohm Vape Kits. As it’s the perfect E Liquid ratio for large cloud creation that doesn’t lessen your vape juice flavour. Allowing you to enjoy your favourite Riot Squad flavours to the max. Using naturally derived vegetable glycerine and propylene glycol with pharmaceutical-grade nicotine. Riot Squad’s Vape Juices are renowned for their supreme quality and ability to deliver huge flavoursome vapour clouds. So if you are looking for delicious flavour and high-quality E-Liquids for your vapes, you can be confident the Riot Squad UK-based E-Liquid manufacturer will deliver premium, flavourful vapour clouds and explosively delicious flavours in every puff! If you love this delicious Riot Squad Shortfill 50ml, then check out their other equally moreish 10ml & 50ml E-Liquids. Designed to suit any vapers flavour requirements, you’re bound to find a Riot Squad Vape juice you’ll love. Go ahead treat your taste buds to an explosion of juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverages, Confectionary/desserts, classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours from Riot Squad's delicious Black Edition, Menthol, BAR EDTN and Punx E-Liquid ranges. Love the flavour of Riot Squad Shortfills, but don’t want the hassle of refilling or maintaining your vape device? Check out the Riot Squad Disposable Vapes . These super convenient Disposable Vapes are a great way to enjoy your favourite Riot Squad flavours on the go.
